key_points: QIA agrees $20bn investment mandate with JPM Asset Management for global equities and credit.
JPM raised quarterly dividend to $1.65/share from $1.50, signaling strong capital return capacity.
Several institutional investors increased holdings (Proficio Capital, Fayez Sarofim, Corient, Bank of America).
Oil price forecast uncertainty noted but limited direct impact on JPM's earnings.
CEO commentary on hyperscaler AI spending $1trn next year highlights potential banking upside.
